title: Cad Play Vertex Edge Kernel Solid
description: CAD play: moving vertices or edges produces wrong boxy blocky solids and overlapping shapes. Fix kernel solid computation on topology edit.
summary: Generalized brepjs solid derivation: shell topology is the only source for meshed solids; stale box primitives and axis-aligned AABB proxy boxes removed. solidFromModelTopology now builds one face per shell face (outer wire), sews with sewShells/healSolid, then falls back to solid(). Primitives apply only when no shell graph (spheres/cylinders). Added sheared-box regression test. Renderer footprint suppression unchanged. All brepjs (27) and renderer (57) tests pass.
